title: CYCLIC-LOG: smooth logarithmic boost and plateau with charged rational parameter computation

claims.statement: For every N>=2 and every s in Z/NZ, with n=ceil(log2 N), the single CYCLIC-LOG algorithm/configuration in proof.md and cyclic_base.md recovers the entire s with unconditional probability at least 1-2^-8 from independent ideal coset copies. Jointly on every execution branch, its total charged sequential work T is O(n^3 2^(a sqrt(n)+6sqrt(n)/(log2 n)^2)), as a uniform eventually positive representative envelope evaluated for n>=512 and extended positively on the finite smaller prefix. All outside constants are absolute and independent of N,s and outcomes. Here , the exact Pell rational u_333/v_333 of cyclic_base.md Section 0. This envelope has exact growth index 1/2. The smooth rational-logarithm boost and plateau, below-four retry factor, recomputed actual decoder/extractor parameters, and literal Q_star=8 A_star(G_odd+2a2)+2a2, Qcap=1024 Q_star replace the old fixed16 configuration. The resource accounting includes rational logarithm computation and every charged operation; the classical claim uses the actual high-part field widths and geometric/plateau stack sum proved in proof.md.
